in_marathi.name: Darshak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darshak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Darshak means ‘observer’ or ‘seer’. It is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology, as it is believed to be the name of the divine messenger or the one who reveals truth.
